definitions.explanation: Exceptionally cheap, much lower than the normal or expected price. Commonly used in advertising and consumer contexts. Composed of 格 (standard) + 安 (cheap) — implying unusually cheap.

examples.japanese: {格安|かくやす}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{航空券|こうくうけん}→航空券：19426_koukuuken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a bargain airline ticket.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{格安|かくやす}で⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: This shop is cheap and the quality is good too.

examples.japanese: {格安|かくやす}⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}えたら→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧になった。
examples.english: When I switched to a budget smartphone plan, my monthly bill was cut in half.

notes:
USAGE:
{格安|かくやす} modifies nouns directly (without な in many compounds): {格安|かくやす}{航空券|こうくうけん}, {格安|かくやす}SIM. It is widely used in advertising and shopping contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格安|かくやす}{航空会社|こうくうがいしゃ} (budget airline, LCC)
- {格安|かくやす}SIM (budget SIM card)
- {格安|かくやす}⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧ (budget smartphone plan)
- {格安|かくやす}⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧ (bargain property)
- {格安|かくやす}で⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to get at a bargain price)
